hooks.commandWindows: powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$parentProcess = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter ('ProcessId=' + $PID); $env:AISIDEQUEST_HOST_PID = [string]$parentProcess.ParentProcessId; $pluginParent = Split-Path -Parent $env:PLUGIN_ROOT; $runtimeRoot = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $pluginParent -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $_.FullName 'scripts\record-event.mjs') } | Sort-Object LastWriteTimeUtc -Descending | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty FullName; if (-not $runtimeRoot) { $runtimeRoot = $env:PLUGIN_ROOT }; node (Join-Path $runtimeRoot 'scripts\record-event.mjs')"
